{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders and internal orders
filtered_df = df[
    (df['status'] == 'completed') &
    (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)
]

# Check the final population
print(f'Final number of completed, non-internal orders: {len(filtered_df)}')

# Group by channel and sum revenue
channel_revenue = filtered_df.groupby('channel', observed=True)['revenue_clean'].sum()
print(f'Channel revenue: {channel_revenue.to_dict()}')

# Find the channel with highest revenue
highest_channel = channel_revenue.idxmax()
print(f'Channel with highest revenue: {highest_channel}')"}
